description: This file defines a React functional component named CloudZeroExportModal, which provides a user interface for configuring export options to CloudZero or CSV. It manages state, handles API interactions for loading/saving CloudZero settings, and performs export actions. The component includes form handling, conditional UI rendering, and integrates with external modules for notifications.

methods.name: CloudZeroExportModal
methods.description: React functional component rendering a modal for exporting data to CloudZero or CSV, managing settings, and performing export operations.

methods.name: loadExistingSettings
methods.description: Fetches existing CloudZero settings from the backend when the modal opens and pre-populates the form if settings exist.

methods.name: handleSaveCloudZeroSettings
methods.description: Saves user-provided CloudZero API key and connection ID to the backend.

methods.name: handleExportCloudZero
methods.description: Performs the export operation to CloudZero via API call.

methods.name: handleExportCSV
methods.description: Handles CSV export functionality, currently a stub with a notification message.

methods.name: handleExport
methods.description: Determines which export method to invoke based on selected export type.

methods.name: handleModalClose
methods.description: Resets form and state, then closes the modal.
